about.title: About Penrose Tiling
about.intro: A tile-laying game built on the kites and darts of the Penrose tiling. Every tile must obey the matching rules; the game ends as soon as the boundary has a gap that no tile can fill.
about.fonts.title: Fonts
about.fonts.credit: The interface fonts are based on LINE Seed Sans and LINE Seed TW by LY Corporation. This game keeps only the characters the interface uses and renames them PTG Sans and PTG Sans TC, distributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.

settings.arcs.note: Arc colors adapt to the color scheme automatically. Turn the arcs off to see only the shapes, as a harder mode.
